method.name: milp_set_cover
steps: Define binary decision variables x_A, x_B, ..., x_L where x_i = 1 if a store is built at location i, else 0
Objective: minimize sum(x_i) for i in {A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J,K,L}
Constraint for each area: sum of x_j for all j in within_800m[area] >= 1 (each area must be covered)
Use HiGHS MILP solver with binary variables
Retrieve optimal solution: stores at locations where x_i = 1

method.name: enumerate_min_subset
steps: Use brute-force enumeration: try k=1,2,3,... locations
For each k, generate all C(12,k) combinations of potential store locations
For each combination, check if all 12 areas are covered
Stop at the smallest k that yields a valid covering
Return the first valid combination found at that k

method.name: greedy_set_cover
steps: Repeat until all areas covered: pick the location that covers the most currently-uncovered areas, break ties arbitrarily
Add that location to the store set
Mark all areas covered by the new store as covered
Return the set of selected locations (approximate, not guaranteed optimal)
